restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: LSASS memory access by non-standard processes, SAM/NTDS.dit or registry hive reads, credential-dumping tool execution (e.g., Mimikatz, procdump on lsass), suspicious access to DPAPI secrets or browser credential stores, and subsequent authentication with harvested accounts.
what_would_refute: No process access to LSASS or credential stores, no dumping tool artifacts or hive copies, and no anomalous authentication using accounts whose credentials reside on the affected hosts.
